description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kiribamunegama, Polpithigama D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 421477 (24/0882)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and declarations of title determination for specific land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels with ownership details (all owned by "The State"), parcel numbers, extents, and other land-specific particulars. The content falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and title settlements for multiple land parcels in Kiribamunegama.
